ContactInquiry.title: ContactInquiry
ContactInquiry.description: A validated B2B contact inquiry submitted through the BusyBug IT Solutions website.

referenceId.description: Unique human-readable ticket reference ID (e.g., BB-4821).

name.description: Full name of the submitting contact.

email.description: Email address of the submitting contact.

phone.description: Phone number of the submitting contact.

message.description: Detailed project, audit, or inquiry message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Write-once public contact submissions readable and triaged solely by verified BusyBug admins.
